description: A signed, dated compliance certificate an allocator can actually. use it rather than `assess_spend_anomaly` for mandate compliance, not spend anomaly; an object with 32 fields including actual, asOf. $5 USDC.

as_of.description: The date the answer is computed as of (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today. Use it to reproduce a past answer exactly.
as_of.title: As Of

mandate.description: The mandate this operation operates on. See the schema for its type and whether it is required.

observations.description: The observations this operation operates on. See the schema for its type and whether it is required.

portfolio.description: The portfolio this operation operates on. See the schema for its type and whether it is required.

name: assess_mandate_compliance

as_of.description: The date the answer is computed as of.

canonicalization.description: The canonicalisation rule the digest was computed under.

checks.description: The individual checks that were run.

evidence_core.description: The canonical, signed core of the answer — the payload the signature covers.

methodology_version.description: Version of the method that produced the answer.

note.description: A note on how the answer was produced.

output_sha256.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the canonical evidence core.

rule.description: The rule or criteria that decided the verdict.

signature.description: The Ed25519 signature over the evidence core, base64-encoded.

signed_by.description: The key id that signed the answer.

title: Assess Mandate Compliance
